responses.question: Does the organization have a formal Vulnerability Management Policy (VMP)?
Is the VMP reviewed and updated at least annually?
Is vulnerability management aligned to a security framework (e.g., CIS, NIST, ISO)?
Is there a dedicated governance board or committee overseeing the VM program?
Are VM policies disseminated and communicated across all business units?
Are regulatory requirements (SOX, PCI, GDPR, etc.) formally mapped to VM controls?
Is there a formal exception process documented and enforced?
Are VM program goals and KPIs formally defined and tracked?
Does the organization have a formal risk management program?
Is a risk scoring methodology used to prioritize vulnerabilities?
Does the risk scoring incorporate asset or data criticality?
Is a formal risk acceptance process defined for unmitigated risks?
Are business impact assessments (BIA) conducted on critical systems?
Is the organization's risk appetite formally documented?
Are network diagrams and data flows documented?
Are compensating controls considered when prioritizing remediation?
Are security controls continuously validated?
Does the organization maintain an asset inventory (CMDB or equivalent)?
Are assets classified by criticality and data sensitivity?
Are asset owners assigned and documented?
Is the asset inventory integrated with the vulnerability scanner?
Are discovery scans performed to detect rogue/unauthorized devices?
Is a passive discovery tool used as part of the asset management program?
Are baseline configurations documented and validated for assets?
Is port security enabled on network switches?
Are gold images used for new system builds?
Is there a formal process for provisioning and deprovisioning admin accounts?
Are admin accounts centrally managed (e.g., Active Directory)?
Do administrators use separate accounts for admin vs. everyday tasks?
Are shared administrator accounts prohibited?
Are admin accounts reviewed quarterly for access appropriateness?
Are admin accounts restricted from browsing the Internet?
Are alerts configured for admin account misuse?
Is role-based security training provided to users with admin rights?
Are vulnerability scans performed on a regular, scheduled basis?
Are authenticated (credentialed) scans performed?
Are dedicated service accounts used for scanning?
Are scanning exceptions formally approved and documented?
Are discovery scans performed to identify rogue devices?
Are scan results compared cycle-to-cycle to track changes?
Are Insight Agents deployed for continuous endpoint assessment?
Is the PCI or other regulated environment scanned separately?
Is a formal scanning standard documented (frequency, etiquette, ownership)?
Are false positives identified and removed from remediation lists?
Is CVSS score used as a minimum baseline for prioritization?
Does prioritization incorporate asset criticality or data classification?
Are threat intelligence feeds reviewed to prioritize emerging threats?
Is there a formal process for emerging/zero-day threat response?
Are compensating controls factored into vulnerability risk scoring?
Are key metrics defined for the vulnerability analysis phase?
Is risk-based remediation prioritization formally documented?
Is there a formal patch management policy with defined timelines?
Are patches tested in non-production before production deployment?
Are all OS types covered by the patching process (Windows, Linux, etc.)?
Are third-party applications included in the patching program?
Are SLA targets defined for patching by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low)?
Are automated workflows used between vulnerability scanning and patch management?
Are mitigations applied when systems cannot be patched?
Are M&A environments included in the patching program?
Are remediation efforts tracked to completion in a ticketing system?
Is there a formal change management policy?
Is a Change Advisory Board (CAB) or equivalent established?
Are standard, normal, and emergency change types defined?
Are all changes tracked in a ticketing system with audit trails?
Are exceptions included in the change management workflow?
Is monthly patching treated as a standard change (pre-approved)?
Are vulnerability management reports produced on a regular cadence?
Are reports tailored for different audiences (executive, operational, tactical)?
Are KPIs and metrics formally defined for the VM program?
Do reports include risk reduction trends over time?
Are SLA compliance rates reported to senior management?
Are exception and false positive metrics tracked and reported?
Is reporting automated or semi-automated?
Is there a formal security awareness training program?
Are penetration tests conducted at least annually?
Are phishing simulation campaigns conducted?
Is an authorized software/application inventory maintained?
Are business justifications documented for all approved applications?
Are baseline security configurations documented and enforced?
Are policy compliance scans (CIS/STIG) performed?
Are unsigned scripts/executables blocked from running in browsers?
Is there a third-party/supplier security assessment process?
